en: Isaiah 40

p.src: 1  “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.

ja: 「わたしの民を慰めよ。慰めよ」と、あなたがたの
en: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.
u.src: 1  “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.

p.src: 2  “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of the LORD’s hand double for all her sins.”

en: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of the LORD’s hand double for all her sins.”

en: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of the LORD in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.

zh: 40:3 或譯：在曠野，有人聲喊着說：當預備耶和華的路

en: The LORD’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of the LORD has spoken it.”

ja: くからだ。 まことに、

en: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”

れてはならない。 ユダの

p.src: 10  Behold, the Lord GOD will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.

ja: とともにあり、 その
en: Behold, the Lord GOD will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.
u.src: 10  Behold, the Lord GOD will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.

p.src: 11  He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.

en: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.

zh: 以色列的上帝無可比擬

p.src: 12  Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measuring basket, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

en: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measuring basket, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

p.src: 13  Who has directed the LORD’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?

ja: を導き、 助言者として
en: Who has directed the LORD’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?
u.src: 13  Who has directed the LORD’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?

zh: 40:13 或譯：誰曾指示耶和華的靈

p.src: 14  Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?

en: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?
u.src: 14  Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?

p.src: 15  Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.

ja: のちりのようにみなされる。
en: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.

en: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.

p.src: 17  All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.

ja: たず、むなしいものとみなされる。
en: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.
u.src: 17  All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.

p.src: 19  A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.

en: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.
u.src: 19  A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.

ja: そのようなささげ物をする
を据えるために、熟練した職人を捜す。
en: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up a carved image for him that will not be moved.
u.src: 20  He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up a carved image for him that will not be moved.

p.src: 21  Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? Haven’t you been told from the beginning? Haven’t you understood from the foundations of the earth?

en: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? Haven’t you been told from the beginning? Haven’t you understood from the foundations of the earth?

p.src: 22  It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in,

民はいなごのようだ。 この方は

u.src: 22  It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in,

ja: 判官たちをむなしいものとされる。
en: who brings princes to nothing, who makes the judges of the earth meaningless.
u.src: 23  who brings princes to nothing, who makes the judges of the earth meaningless.

p.src: 24  They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.

ろしたかと思う間もなく、 主が
らはしおれ、 つむじ
en: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.

en: “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.

en: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

p.src: 30  Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;

en: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;
